generatedFor: How to Get Away with Murder

beats.label: S1 · Five chosen, one body
beats.text: Criminal law professor Annalise Keating picks five students to work at her firm just as missing sorority girl Lila Stangard turns up dead in a water tank.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the ensemble, Annalise's power over them, and the murder that will unravel the whole household.

beats.label: S1 · Wes and Rebecca
beats.text: Wes discovers Annalise's husband Sam was Lila's secret lover, and prime suspect Rebecca — Wes's next-door neighbour — becomes his obsession as he fights to clear her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Locks Wes as Annalise's antagonist inside her own house and gives the season its investigator.

beats.label: S1 · Sam over the banister
beats.text: When Sam is exposed as Lila's lover and probable killer, a panicked Rebecca breaks into the house and Michaela shoves Sam over the banister trying to save her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The single event that will define every relationship in the show from here on.

beats.label: S1 · The trophy and the fire
beats.text: Sam gets back up and attacks Rebecca; Wes finishes him with a trophy. The four students burn his body and dispose of the remains, sworn to bury the night forever.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Binds the Keating Four to Annalise through shared murder and gives them the secret they must all keep.

beats.label: S1 · Nate takes the fall
beats.text: When Sam's remains surface, Annalise coldly frames her lover Detective Nate Lahey for the killing rather than let her students go down for it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shows exactly how far Annalise will go to protect the group, and poisons the Annalise–Nate relationship for years.

beats.label: S1 · Rebecca in the basement
beats.text: The students corner Rebecca in Annalise's basement, convinced she killed Lila. She insists she is innocent and is left tied up while Annalise decides her fate.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The last hours of Rebecca alive and the setup for the season's final twist.

beats.label: S1 · Frank did it
beats.text: Rebecca is found dead beneath the stairs; a flashback reveals Frank strangled Lila on Sam's orders, meaning Sam had his own pregnant lover murdered to protect himself.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Rewrites the entire season: Sam was the villain from day one and Frank is a killer, both hidden inside Annalise's inner circle.

cliffhanger.text: Rebecca is dead in Annalise's basement. Annalise and Frank each ask the other 'did you do it?' and neither believes the answer, while the four students remain bound to Annalise by Sam's murder and know none of it.
questions: Will the students ever find out Frank killed Lila?
How long can Nate stay in jail for a murder he did not commit?

characters.name: Annalise Keating
characters.line: Defense attorney and law professor; covered up her husband's murder and framed her lover Nate to protect five students bound to her by shared guilt.

characters.name: Wes Gibbins
characters.line: The quiet, outsider student Annalise seems to favour; killed Sam to save Rebecca and has just lost her.

characters.name: Sam Keating
characters.line: Annalise's dead husband; got Lila pregnant and ordered Frank to kill her.

characters.name: Frank Delfino
characters.line: Annalise's fixer; strangled Lila for Sam and may or may not have killed Rebecca to protect Annalise.

characters.name: Bonnie Winterbottom
characters.line: Annalise's fiercely loyal junior associate; slept with Asher.

characters.name: Connor Walsh
characters.line: Ambitious gay student unravelling under the cover-up; in a fragile relationship with the HIV-positive hacker Oliver.

characters.name: Michaela Pratt
characters.line: The perfectionist fiancée who shoved Sam; engagement broken, image cracking.

characters.name: Laurel Castillo
characters.line: The group's quiet strategist; fell for Frank without knowing what he is.

characters.name: Nate Lahey
characters.line: Detective and Annalise's ex-lover; sitting in jail framed by her for Sam's murder.

characters.name: Rebecca Sutter
characters.line: Wes's girlfriend and Lila's friend; freshly dead under Annalise's basement stairs.

beats.label: S2 · Bonnie killed Rebecca
beats.text: Bonnie quietly confesses to Annalise she killed Rebecca to protect her, and the group moves on to a new case defending wealthy siblings Caleb and Catherine Hapstall.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Answers the previous cliffhanger and shows the group has already absorbed one more murder without blinking.

beats.label: S2 · Wes goes hunting
beats.text: Wes uncovers 'EGGS911' as Rebecca's foster brother Levi; his hunt for her killer pulls him and Nate into open war against Annalise.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Wes turns from Annalise's dependent to her active enemy, driving him toward the season's turning point.

beats.label: S2 · Philip and Sinclair close in
beats.text: A hidden Hapstall heir, Philip Jessup, starts stalking the team from the shadows while ADA Emily Sinclair grinds toward exposing Annalise's household.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up both the outside threat that panics the group and the prosecutor whose death will trigger the season's cover-up.

beats.label: S2 · Sinclair in the driveway
beats.text: Enraged after his father's suicide, Asher runs Sinclair down with his car; Annalise choreographs a cover-up at the Hapstall mansion and orders Wes to shoot her to sell it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The new communal murder that replaces Sam as the group's binding secret, and the setup for the season's opening image.

beats.label: S2 · Christophe
beats.text: Wes fires. A dying Annalise whispers his birth name, 'Christophe,' and Wes realises she has secretly known him since childhood.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Detonates the show's central mystery: Annalise's link to Wes is not accident but design.

beats.label: S2 · The Mahoneys and the crash
beats.text: Flashbacks reveal Annalise once defended Charles Mahoney with Rose as a witness, and lost her own baby in a car crash arranged by Wallace Mahoney after Frank bugged her room.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ties every character's grief to a single origin event and marks Frank as complicit in Annalise's worst loss.

beats.label: S2 · Wallace on the sidewalk
beats.text: Annalise banishes Frank after learning he killed Lila for Sam; Wes finally meets his biological father, Wallace Mahoney, who is shot dead in front of him seconds later.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the season with a fresh killing, Frank in the wind, and Wes newly parentless and unmoored.

cliffhanger.text: Wes has just watched his real father executed on the street. Frank has vanished with a suitcase of Mahoney cash, and no one knows who ordered Wallace's hit or what Frank will do next.
questions: Where has Frank gone, and can anyone still trust him?
Now that Wes knows Annalise has been shaping his life since childhood, can he still stand her?

characters.name: Annalise Keating
characters.line: Recovering from Wes's gunshot; exposed as having known Wes since he was a child and once carrying Sam's stillborn son.

characters.name: Wes Gibbins
characters.line: Learned Annalise has always been in his life; just watched his biological father shot dead in front of him.

characters.name: Bonnie Winterbottom
characters.line: Killed Rebecca; still devoted to Annalise; helped throw Sinclair's body off the roof.

characters.name: Frank Delfino
characters.line: Exposed as the man whose bug on Annalise's room enabled Wallace to arrange the crash that killed her baby, and who strangled Lila for Sam; on the run.

characters.name: Laurel Castillo
characters.line: Reconciled with Wes after Frank's betrayal; now fluent in every one of the group's crimes.

characters.name: Connor Walsh
characters.line: Increasingly wrecked by the coverups; still with Oliver.

characters.name: Michaela Pratt
characters.line: Coping; started something with Asher.

characters.name: Asher Millstone
characters.line: Killed ADA Sinclair with his car after his father's suicide; now permanently inside the group's secrets.

characters.name: Nate Lahey
characters.line: Out of prison; on-off with Annalise; his sick wife Nia has died.

characters.name: Oliver Hampton
characters.line: HIV-positive; hacker; increasingly folded into Annalise's world after quitting his job.

beats.label: S3 · Killer flyers
beats.text: Two months on, someone is papering Middleton with flyers calling Annalise a killer; she starts drinking again as her past closes in.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the season's tone of siege from outside and self-destruction from within.

beats.label: S3 · Frank comes home
beats.text: Frank surfaces from hiding, executes Bonnie's abusive father in prison as a peace offering, and slowly re-enters the group's orbit.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Frank's return puts every character back in reach of him for what follows.

beats.label: S3 · Wes, Laurel, and the frame
beats.text: Wes and Laurel become a couple and she gets pregnant, just as new evidence from the Mahoneys puts Wes in the frame for Wallace's murder.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The pregnancy is the thread that survives Wes and the frame is the pretext that gets him killed.

beats.label: S3 · The house burns
beats.text: On the night Wes is due to sign a police immunity deal, Annalise's house is firebombed and Wes's body is pulled from the basement.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's central loss and the event that reorganises every relationship on the show.

beats.label: S3 · Annalise on trial
beats.text: Annalise is arrested for arson and murder; her only way out is to prove Wes was dead before the fire ever started.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Frames the investigation that will eventually surface Wes's real killer.

beats.label: S3 · The rib crack
beats.text: Connor admits he found Wes already dead in the basement and heard a rib crack while doing CPR; the group realises Wes was murdered before the fire.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The pivot from Annalise's guilt to a new killer entirely.

beats.label: S3 · Dominic and the Castillos
beats.text: Wes's real killer is exposed as Dominic, a fixer for Laurel's father; Laurel arms herself to shoot Charles Mahoney but Dominic intercepts her first.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the season's true villain — Jorge Castillo — and puts Laurel and her unborn child directly in his line of sight.

cliffhanger.text: Wes is dead, killed on the orders of Laurel's own father Jorge Castillo to keep him quiet about the Mahoneys. Laurel is pregnant with Wes's child and has just been ambushed in the street by his killer.
questions: What does Dominic want with Laurel and her unborn child?
How far will Jorge Castillo go to protect his empire?
Can Annalise rebuild anything after burying Wes?

characters.name: Annalise Keating
characters.line: Alcoholic, charges dropped after pinning Sam and Rebecca's deaths on the dead Wes; hollowed out by his loss.

characters.name: Wes Gibbins
characters.line: Dead, murdered before Annalise's house was firebombed to hide it.

characters.name: Laurel Castillo
characters.line: Pregnant with Wes's baby; just discovered her own father ordered his killing and is now cornered by his fixer.

characters.name: Frank Delfino
characters.line: Back in Annalise's orbit; killed for Bonnie and has taken the fall for Wes's death to buy time.

characters.name: Bonnie Winterbottom
characters.line: Grieving her love for Frank; still Annalise's protector.

characters.name: Connor Walsh
characters.line: Bore the guilt of finding Wes's body and heard the rib crack; back with Oliver.

characters.name: Michaela Pratt
characters.line: Openly with Asher; still the group's strategist under fire.

characters.name: Asher Millstone
characters.line: Together with Michaela; a full member of the coverup by now.

characters.name: Nate Lahey
characters.line: Left Wes at the house the night he died; ended his fling with the corrupt ADA Atwood.

characters.name: Jorge Castillo
characters.line: Laurel's father and CEO of Antares; ordered Wes killed to protect his empire.

beats.label: S4 · The class action
beats.text: Annalise fires her students, builds a class action for a fair public defence system, and starts court-ordered therapy with psychologist Isaac Roa.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Redefines Annalise's purpose and gives the season its legal engine.

beats.label: S4 · Inside Antares
beats.text: Michaela lands at Caplan & Gold, the firm defending Laurel's father Jorge and his Antares empire; the pair set out to steal proof he ordered Wes's murder.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season-long infiltration that puts the group inside Jorge's world and inside the corporate firm.

beats.label: S4 · Simon and the gun
beats.text: At an Antares gala the plan goes sideways: Simon Drake accidentally shoots himself with Laurel's gun, and Laurel goes into premature labour that night.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's disaster: a new coma victim, a new arrest for Asher, and Laurel's baby delivered under duress.

beats.label: S4 · Jorge takes the baby
beats.text: Jorge weaponises Laurel's mental history and Isaac's own scandal to seize custody of her newborn Christopher the moment he is born.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Raises the personal stakes to unbearable and gives Laurel her reason to bring her father down at any cost.

beats.label: S4 · Supreme Court
beats.text: Annalise takes her class action to the Supreme Court and wins, restoring her career and reputation in a single decision.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The professional victory that gives Annalise the standing to take on Jorge and reset her life.

beats.label: S4 · Jorge falls
beats.text: With Tegan Price's help Annalise turns on Jorge, who is arrested for a string of crimes including DA Denver's suspected murder.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes the season's principal threat and reshuffles power heading into the next chapter.

beats.label: S4 · A living child, a new student
beats.text: Nate uncovers evidence of an unnamed child presumed dead but perhaps alive, and a mysterious new student, Gabriel Maddox, enrols at Middleton with Frank already watching him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Two brand-new mysteries planted in the final minute, both of which will drive what follows.

cliffhanger.text: Jorge is behind bars but his empire is intact. Nate has found a file hinting an unnamed child presumed dead may still be alive, and a stranger named Gabriel Maddox has just walked into Middleton with an agenda no one understands.
questions: Who is Gabriel Maddox and what does he want with Annalise?
Is Bonnie's child really alive, and where has he been?
With Jorge caged, will the Castillos strike back?

characters.name: Annalise Keating
characters.line: Just won at the Supreme Court; sober, licensed, and rebuilding.

characters.name: Laurel Castillo
characters.line: Mother to baby Christopher, cleared of Simon's shooting; her father is jailed and her son is back in her arms.

characters.name: Frank Delfino
characters.line: Studying for the LSAT; a father figure to Laurel's baby; killed Dominic in revenge for Wes.

characters.name: Bonnie Winterbottom
characters.line: Back at the DA's office; helped free Asher and continues to work the class action from inside.

characters.name: Nate Lahey
characters.line: Combing through the corrupt Denver's files; just found evidence of an unnamed child presumed dead but perhaps alive.

characters.name: Connor Walsh
characters.line: Engaged to Oliver; recommitted to law school after nearly walking away.

characters.name: Oliver Hampton
characters.line: Engaged to Connor; Annalise's tech operative on every off-books job.

characters.name: Michaela Pratt
characters.line: Placed Simon on ICE's radar and got him deported to bury the shooting; still with Asher.

characters.name: Tegan Price
characters.line: Sharp Caplan & Gold partner and Annalise's new ally; persuaded to jump ship and help bring Jorge down.

characters.name: Gabriel Maddox
characters.line: Mysterious new Middleton student; Frank suspects he is here about Annalise.

beats.label: S5 · Annalise, three lives
beats.text: Annalise returns to Philadelphia, teaching part-time at Middleton and joining Caplan & Gold alongside Tegan and new managing partner Emmett Crawford.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets Annalise's three overlapping stages — school, firm, home — inside which the season's cover-up will play out.

beats.label: S5 · Bonnie's son
beats.text: Bonnie learns her baby may be alive; her sister Julie eventually confesses she took him from the hospital, but claims she later buried him in the woods.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Answers the previous cliffhanger with fresh grief and gives Bonnie the emotional weight she carries into her worst act.

beats.label: S5 · Miller and Nate Sr.
beats.text: ADA Ronald Miller falls for Bonnie, and when Nate's father is shot dead during a prison transfer, Bonnie and Nate become convinced Miller ordered it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The setup for the season's murder and for Nate's grief-driven collapse.

beats.label: S5 · Wedding night blood
beats.text: On Connor and Oliver's wedding night Nate beats Miller nearly to death; Bonnie finishes him with her bare hands and Nate drives the body away.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The new communal murder that replaces Sam as the group's binding crime — and the one they got wrong.

beats.label: S5 · Gabriel is Sam's son
beats.text: At the same wedding, Frank exposes new student Gabriel Maddox as Sam Keating's son from a first marriage Annalise never knew existed.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns a mystery student into a live grenade sitting in Annalise's class.

beats.label: S5 · Miller was innocent
beats.text: The investigation clears Miller and points to Laurel's brother Xavier, acting on Governor Birkhead's orders, as the real hand behind Nate Sr.'s killing.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals Bonnie and Nate killed the wrong man and puts the Castillos and the Governor back in the frame.

beats.label: S5 · Emmett dies, Laurel vanishes
beats.text: Annalise clears Emmett of murder charges; he is later seen collapsed in his office gasping for air, and Laurel and baby Christopher disappear from Annalise's side.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Two catastrophic exits at the finish line, both driving the next chapter of the show.

cliffhanger.text: Bonnie and Nate murdered an innocent man to avenge a killing they misread. Emmett is on the floor of his office gasping for air, Laurel has vanished with her son, and the Governor and Castillos are still moving pieces around Annalise.
questions: Where are Laurel and Christopher, and who took them?
What will Gabriel do now that he knows who his father really was?

characters.name: Annalise Keating
characters.line: Back on top after the Supreme Court; standing over another body she cannot account for as her closest people vanish.

characters.name: Bonnie Winterbottom
characters.line: Killed an innocent man for revenge she now knows was misplaced; still hiding the truth from Miller's grieving mother.

characters.name: Frank Delfino
characters.line: Bonnie's lover again; the one who unmasked Gabriel and covered for her murder of Miller.

characters.name: Nate Lahey
characters.line: Helped Bonnie beat and dispose of Miller; his father was in fact murdered by the Castillos on the Governor's orders.

characters.name: Laurel Castillo
characters.line: Vanished with baby Christopher moments after learning her brother orchestrated Nate Sr.'s killing.

characters.name: Gabriel Maddox
characters.line: Sam Keating's estranged son, planted in Annalise's life with reasons of his own.

characters.name: Connor Walsh
characters.line: Newly married to Oliver; back to Annalise's inner circle after the wedding-night cover-up.

characters.name: Michaela Pratt
characters.line: Slept with both Asher and Gabriel; more entangled and less in control of any of it than ever.

characters.name: Asher Millstone
characters.line: In the DA's office; the heartbroken third wheel in Michaela's love life.

characters.name: Tegan Price
characters.line: Partner at Caplan & Gold alongside the new managing partner Emmett; Annalise's confidante and secret ally against the Castillos.

beats.label: S6 · Rehab and homecoming
beats.text: In rehab Annalise begins to forgive herself; back in Philadelphia she leads the students through the same exercise and then Laurel and Christopher reappear.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resets Annalise emotionally and closes the previous cliffhanger about Laurel's disappearance.

beats.label: S6 · Vivian and the FBI
beats.text: Gabriel's mother Vivian reveals she is working with the FBI, who are still hunting the group for Sam's murder and everything that followed.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the outside threat that will circle Annalise for the rest of the series.

beats.label: S6 · Xavier snapped
beats.text: Frank captures and tortures Xavier, who confesses to Nate that he helped murder Nate Sr. for Governor Birkhead; Nate then snaps his neck.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the Nate Sr. thread with a fresh murder and puts the Governor directly on the group's target list.

beats.label: S6 · Asher the mole
beats.text: Asher is unmasked as the FBI's informant and killed outside Gabriel's building; Connor and Michaela are arrested for it and cut immunity deals against Annalise.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills a founding member of the group and splits the survivors from Annalise for the first time.

beats.label: S6 · Mexico and the DOJ
beats.text: Annalise flees to Mexico under a fake identity; she is caught, hauled home, and faces capital charges built on every crime the group has ever committed.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Annalise's own life on the line for the finale, and forces her to defend herself against the people she once protected.

beats.label: S6 · Frank is a Keating
beats.text: Annalise discovers Frank is the child of an incestuous relationship between Sam and his sister Hannah; days later Hannah is found dead before she can testify.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The show's last great secret about Sam; recasts Frank's whole history inside the Keating family.

beats.label: S6 · Verdict and gunfire
beats.text: Annalise is acquitted; at the press conference Frank shoots Governor Birkhead dead and he and Bonnie are cut down by return fire, while Jorge is stabbed in prison.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The finale's simultaneous reckoning: Annalise walks free, and everyone who fought hardest for her dies in the same minute.

cliffhanger.text: Annalise walks out of court a free woman just as Frank and Bonnie are gunned down avenging her. A flashforward decades on shows Laurel and Wes's grown son Christopher inheriting Annalise's chair at Middleton after her funeral.
questions: How does Annalise live the rest of her life after burying Frank, Bonnie, and Asher?
What becomes of Michaela, Connor, Oliver, Laurel, and Nate once they scatter?
What kind of teacher does Wes's son grow up to be in Annalise's classroom?

characters.name: Annalise Keating
characters.line: Acquitted of every charge; lost Frank and Bonnie the same day she walked free.

characters.name: Bonnie Winterbottom
characters.line: Killed in the gunfire outside the courthouse alongside Frank.

characters.name: Frank Delfino
characters.line: Revealed as Sam and Hannah's son; killed Governor Birkhead in vengeance and died beside Bonnie.

characters.name: Laurel Castillo
characters.line: Returned with baby Christopher; helped Tegan arrange her own father's murder in prison.

characters.name: Nate Lahey
characters.line: Killed Xavier and forced the Governor's role into the light; grief for his father finally answered.

characters.name: Connor Walsh
characters.line: Took the immunity deal against Annalise; still married to Oliver.

characters.name: Michaela Pratt
characters.line: Took the immunity deal against Annalise; her law-school family blown apart.

characters.name: Asher Millstone
characters.line: The FBI's mole; beaten to death in Gabriel's building by a corrupt agent.

characters.name: Tegan Price
characters.line: Ally to the very end; helped Laurel arrange Jorge's death in exchange for a fortune.

characters.name: Gabriel Maddox
characters.line: Now knows Annalise's version of Sam's death and leaves Philadelphia at his mother's urging.
